reason: Hypothesis A directly addresses the research question's constraints by proposing a model that separately predicts lattice and electronic contributions, explicitly includes oxygen defects (matching the cited 1 wt.% oxygen data), and sets a specific, falsifiable target (±20% of 10–17 W/(K·m) from 300–1200 K and comparable contributions below 200 K).
